title: Complete Web Development Bootcamp
instructor_bio: Senior full-stack engineer and educator with over 8 years of experience building scalable web applications and mentoring aspiring developers.
description: Learn full-stack web development from scratch with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, React, and Node.js through real-world projects.
what_you_will_learn: Build full-stack web applications and deploy to the cloud
Master modern JavaScript (ES6+), React 19, and Tailwind CSS
Create robust REST APIs with Node.js and Express
Implement user authentication and MongoDB database management

curriculum.title: Web Fundamentals: HTML5 Semantic Structure & Modern CSS
JavaScript Mastery: Modern ES6+, DOM & Async Programming
Frontend Engineering with React & Tailwind CSS

title: Modern React.js Development
instructor_bio: Frontend architect specializing in modern React ecosystems, performance optimization, and production-ready component libraries.
description: Build high-performance, interactive single page web applications using modern React patterns, custom hooks, and state management.
what_you_will_learn: Master React Hooks, Custom Hooks, and Context API
Implement scalable state management solutions
Optimize rendering performance and handle asynchronous operations
Build production-grade dynamic interfaces with smooth animations

curriculum.title: State Architecture: Context API & Custom Hooks

title: UI/UX Design Masterclass
instructor_bio: Lead product designer with a background in designing consumer apps, complex design systems, and conducting iterative UX research.
description: Learn the complete end-to-end design process from wireframing, typography, color theory, and prototyping in Figma to handoff.
what_you_will_learn: Master Figma tools, auto-layout, components, and design systems
Understand user research, user journey mapping, and wireframing
Design accessible, modern UI layouts with balanced typography and color
Create interactive prototypes and prepare assets for developer handoff

curriculum.title: Foundations of UX: User Research & Information Architecture
Figma Essentials: Auto-Layout, Variants & Component Tokens

title: Python for Data Science
instructor_bio: Data scientist and quantitative analyst passionate about exploratory data analysis, statistical modeling, and teaching practical Python.
description: Analyze complex datasets, clean structured data, and build insightful statistical visual dashboards using Python, NumPy, and Pandas.
what_you_will_learn: Clean, filter, aggregate, and reshape structured datasets with Pandas
Perform numerical computations and matrix algebra using NumPy
Create statistical charts with Matplotlib and Seaborn
Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA) on real-world datasets

curriculum.title: Python Environment Setup & Core Data Structures
Data Wrangling & Manipulation with NumPy and Pandas

title: Digital Marketing Fundamentals
instructor_bio: Growth marketing consultant with proven success executing high-ROI paid media campaigns, SEO strategies, and conversion funnels.
description: Learn search engine optimization (SEO), social media marketing campaigns, high-converting copy, and paid advertising funnels.
what_you_will_learn: Master keyword research, technical SEO, and on-page optimization
Set up target-driven Google Search & Meta ad campaigns
Build automated email marketing workflows and high-converting funnels
Track marketing ROI and conversion funnels with Google Analytics

curriculum.title: SEO Foundations: Keywords, On-Page & Technical Audits
Paid Ads: Meta Ads Manager & Google Search Ads

title: Machine Learning with Python
instructor_bio: Machine learning researcher and engineer specialized in predictive algorithmic models, neural architectures, and end-to-end deployment.
description: Understand core machine learning theory, build predictive algorithms with Scikit-Learn, and deploy trained models via APIs.
what_you_will_learn: Implement supervised learning (Regression, Decision Trees, SVM)
Apply unsupervised algorithms (K-Means, PCA Dimensionality Reduction)
Evaluate models with cross-validation, precision, recall, and ROC curves
Deploy trained ML models to production with FastAPI and cloud platforms

title: Professional Graphic Design
instructor_bio: Creative director and digital artist with 10+ years shaping brand aesthetics, print collaterals, and vector illustration systems.
description: Master visual brand identity, digital vector illustration, photo retouching, and commercial layout design using Photoshop and Illustrator.
what_you_will_learn: Master vector drafting, logo creation, and brand assets in Illustrator
Advanced photo compositing, masks, and color correction in Photoshop
Apply strict typography grids and visual hierarchy rules
Prepare assets for digital publications and commercial print outputs

curriculum.title: Design Principles: Composition, Contrast & Color Theory
Vector Crafting: Branding, Badges & Logo Design
Brand Guidelines Creation & Production Asset Export

title: Introduction to Cybersecurity
instructor_bio: Information security analyst and certified ethical hacker focused on web vulnerability detection and infrastructure defense.
description: Learn cybersecurity fundamentals, network defense strategies, malware analysis concepts, and enterprise vulnerability prevention.
what_you_will_learn: Understand TCP/IP networking, packet analysis, and firewalls
Identify common web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10)
Learn encryption algorithms, hashing, and public-key infrastructure
Formulate incident response plans and digital security hardening guides

curriculum.title: Threat Modeling: Malware, Phishing & Social Engineering
